visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing white floral pajamas with blue patterns, sits upright on a bed. She smiles broadly at the camera, her eyes crinkling, and waves with both hands in a friendly greeting. The background shows a cozy bedroom with a cream-colored headboard, beige pillows, and a large landscape painting on the wall. A modern desk lamp glows warmly on the wooden nightstand. (2) The woman transitions to lying back against the pillows, holding a black smartphone with her hands. She adopts a frustrated facial expression, squinting her eyes and slightly pouting while looking at the bottom of the device, simulating the struggle of plugging in a charging cable in low light. The bedside lamp remains the primary light source, creating soft shadows. (3) She effortlessly moves the phone toward a white magnetic wireless charging stand on the wooden nightstand. The phone snaps into place, and a circular green charging animation immediately appears on the screen. She smiles with satisfaction and gives a thumbs-up gesture towards the camera, highlighting the ease of use. (4) A detailed close-up shot focuses on the white charging stand. The phone is attached horizontally, displaying the time 4:56 on a large digital clock interface. A pair of black wireless earbuds in a protective case sits on the circular charging base below the phone. The wooden grain of the nightstand is clearly visible. (5) The woman, still lying in bed, reaches out with her right hand to tilt the neck of the charging stand, demonstrating its adjustable height and angle. She points at the phone screen while resting her head comfortably on the pillow, suggesting a hands-free entertainment setup. The white comforter is pulled up to her waist. (6) She holds up a small, vibrant pink jar of Laneige Lip Sleeping Mask. She unscrews the lid and uses a small white applicator to apply a layer of the product to her lips while looking directly into the lens. Her expression is focused yet pleasant, showcasing the skincare routine. (7) The woman presents a black and light-green Beneunder eye mask to the camera. She uses both hands to squeeze and manipulate the thick, padded fabric, demonstrating its soft texture and volume. The mask has a wide strap and a contoured shape designed for comfort. (8) She places the eye mask over her eyes and secures it behind her head. She moves her hands in a waving motion in front of her face to show that she cannot see anything, then smiles and nods toward the lamp to indicate complete light blockage. The scene ends with her looking relaxed and ready for sleep.
